title: Rectified Looped Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2611.16265v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared block, offering a parameter-efficient approach to language modeling. However, most existing works directly reuse each loop's output as the next's input, which can lead to hidden-state scale growth and perturbation amplification as recurrence deepens. We propose Rectified Looped Transformer (RLT), which redesigns feedback between loops using an interpolation schedule inspired by flow-based modeling. At each loop, RLT forms the next input by linearly interpolating between the current state and its prediction. Such interpolation distributes state changes across loops, encouraging a smoother trajectory from the initial input to the final output. Theoretical analysis proves that, under appropriate assumptions, RLT keeps state magnitudes uniformly bounded across loops and reduces the worst-case perturbation amplification. translated_abstract: 循环Transformer通过重复应用共享模块来增加有效深度，为语言建模提供了一种参数高效的方法。然而，大多数现有工作直接将每个循环的输出作为下一个循环的输入，这会随着递归加深而导致隐藏状态规模增长和扰动放大。我们提出整流循环Transformer（RLT），该模型受基于流的建模启发，使用插值调度重新设计了循环之间的反馈机制。在每个循环中，RLT通过在当前状态与其预测之间进行线性插值来构造下一个输入。这种插值将状态变化分布到各个循环中，促使从初始输入到最终输出的轨迹更加平滑。理论分析证明，在适当的假设下，RLT能使状态幅度在各个循环中保持一致有界，并降低最坏情况下的扰动放大。我们在语言建模语料库上对RLT进行了评估。
tldr: 提出整流循环Transformer（RLT），通过受流模型启发的插值调度重新设计循环间反馈，在理论上保证隐藏状态幅度有界并降低扰动放大，从而提升参数高效的语言建模能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes Rectified Looped Transformer (RLT), which redesigns inter-loop feedback via flow-inspired interpolation, provably keeping hidden-state magnitudes uniformly bounded and reducing worst-case perturbation amplification for parameter-efficient language modeling.
